causality: No causal conclusion: this is a 24-row historical QA sample, and it does not establish why the current candidate produced loops. The current 2026-10-26 projection examples are not present in the local workspace.
observed_renderer_behavior: V3 target renderer emits a fixed label for each non-empty semantic field, including per-step labels and per-answer quantity/result labels; this is a systematic format and can create repeated-looking output structure.
QA checks math, grounding, units, steps/hints, answer withholding, grade/language, and provenance, but includes no brevity/redundancy criterion.

Seven sampled student_feedback records are marked as feedback examples and their prompts include actual student work; sampled guard/standard examples do not evidence feedback being invented when work is absent.

Five sampled targets contain an exact repeated rendered line. In these records, repetition maps to distinct source cases/steps or repeated unit fields (e.g. both valid pairs yield 75, both division-check steps yield 788); not evidence of an erroneous generation loop.

recommendation: Do not alter source targets or drop repeated semantic fields in an active run.
